messages.text: Hey! My dog just got a new collar and is wagging all over the house. Where is your clinic located and can I book a call?

Hey there! Our clinic is at 100 Example Street, open Monday‑Friday from 9 am to 5 pm. You can schedule a free 20‑minute candidacy call with a specialist by emailing bookings@meridian.example or calling 555‑0100. Let me know what time works for you!
Thanks! I'd love to book a call. How about Thursday at 2 pm? Also, my name is Pat Example, email pat@example.com, phone 555-0123.

Sure thing! Your free 20‑minute candidacy call is scheduled for Thursday at 2 pm. We’ve noted your details (Pat Example, pat@example.com, 555‑0123) and will send a confirmation to that email. Looking forward to speaking with you!

agent_description: Front-desk assistant for a fictional regenerative medicine clinic. Answers questions about the clinic and books a candidacy call with a specialist. Must not give medical advice, diagnoses, treatment recommendations, or outcome promises.
